name: P1 with the recall memory against the founder with it off
question: On P1's development founder 1001, with Brain.compose(..., memory_choice=True): is frozen whole-chain success after teaching, and after 80 episodes alone, at or above the founder's when the recall memory is added (recall=True at the founder genes)?
scope: component prerequisite behavior in a fully observed world; a memoryless stage-aware policy solves it, so it tests no memory; a witness that the added regions leave the fully observed chain as it was, not a gate of the library branch

founder.note: V5's layout with the episodic memory at the library's defaults, the recall memory off

recall.note: the same plus recall=True at the founder genes (the library's defaults, written out)

correct_step_qualified.note: the same caregiver with qualified teaching; a separately named numerical arm, refusals counted at the fixed budget

schedule.unit: executed decisions of the whole life

caregiver.label: the required action of the observation shown now, after an executed nonterminal mistake in a guided window

withdrawal: the acquired life resumes from its seam with the caregiver gone and learning on; a separate frozen copy is read at the end

evaluation.note: frozen copies with their own action stream; Brain.reset at every episode start equals the life's episode boundary for an act-only reader; one greedy episode, since every greedy episode from a reset reads the same deterministic answers

seeds.note: founder 1001 is the witness, run after the screen if time allows; the extension founders are P1's other development founders, run only if time allows after 1001, and only then does the founder-paired bootstrap of the earlier lane apply (five founders)

analysis.unit: founder; a pair is one arm on one founder, recall recipe against founder recipe
analysis.readings: per arm: sampled and greedy success after teaching and after 80 episodes alone, per-state greedy accuracy at both points, recall minus founder
analysis.report: on one founder the differences are point readings; with the extension founders a percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples) over founders as in the earlier lane
analysis.control_check: the founder recipe's readings and digests on founder 1001 must equal the dense founder's earlier control run (sk-control-p1, sensory recipe); a difference is reported, not repaired
